messages:
Maya (partnerships): Heads-up: SealKey Systems wants to be in our Private Marketplace with SAML SSO + SCIM provisioning + HSM-backed key management. They asked for a security preflight and an announcement embargo. Need volunteers for checklist, legal review, and staging.
Diego (security): I'll draft the preflight checklist. Must include: HSM attestation (module & firmware), KMS integration mode (envelope vs delegated), SAML IdP metadata validation, SCIM schema mapping, and scope for the internal pentest.
Harpreet (solutions-eng): We'll own integration runbooks and the staging tests. SealKey says SCIM supports enterpriseGroup and two custom attrs (employeeType, costCenter). Can we confirm which SCIM attributes we accept?
Omar (infra): Infra points: our Private Marketplace runs with the KMS-forwarder and optionally mounts customer HSM via PKCS#11 proxy. Need to know if SealKey exposes a client cert + mTLS for HSM RPCs or requires our proxy. Also want latency budget for HSM ops (avg 15ms token).
Alex (sealkey): Alex from SealKey here  we support mTLS to the HSM gateway and can provide an attestation report. SCIM attributes: we emit groups and enterpriseInfo.employeeType, enterpriseInfo.costCenter. Happy to share sample payloads.
Maya (partnerships): Quick ask list: security checklist owner (Diego), runbook + harness (Harpreet), infra certs & connector (Omar), legal/SLA review (Jules), embargo/PR (Nina). Proposed sync: Thu 9:30am PT.
Jules (legal): I'll need their SOC2/HIPAA statements and a copy of the proposed Marketplace listing language to review legal claims and logo use. Also confirm data residency requirements for Private listings.
Nina (marketing): For PR we want a 2-week embargo lead and logo assets + partner quote. Can SealKey share an executive quote?
Diego (security): I'll publish the checklist by EOD. Items I'll request from SealKey: HSM vendor & module, FIPS level, attestation report, SAML EntityID + cert, SCIM base URL + token format, threat model notes.
Harpreet (solutions-eng): Staging plan: we can spin up a private sandbox in our staging org. Need a SealKey test tenant + SCIM token. We'll run:
```
# sample SCIM PATCH for group sync
curl -X PATCH "https://staging-sealkey.example/scim/v2/Groups/{id}" 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SEALKEY_TEST' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],"Operations":[{"op":"add","path":"members","value":[{"value":"alice@redwood.com"}]}]}'
```
Harpreet (solutions-eng): We'll validate group membership, custom attrs mapping, and deprovision flows. Also plan a short smoke test for SAML login + provisioning.
Omar (infra): For certs: send CSR to us and we'll sign staging certs with our internal CA. If SealKey wants client certs for mTLS, we can issue short-lived certs via the cert service. Also will prepare a PKCS#11 emulator if their HSM isn't reachable during test.
Alex (sealkey): We'll provide CSR + test tokens by Wed morning. HSM attestation will be available as PDF and a signed report.
Diego (security): Also adding a pentest gate: partner provides app topology, we run a scoped auth & provisioning pentest in staging prior to any production listing. Timeline dependent.
Maya (partnerships): Sounds good. Action items recap: Diego: checklist + pentest gating. Harpreet: runbook & harness. Omar: certs & emulator. Jules: legal review. Nina: PR embargo draft. Alex: supply CSR, SCIM samples, attestation.
deploy-bot: Meeting scheduled: "SealKey Marketplace Onboard" Thu 9:30am PT  invites sent.
Nina (marketing): :thumbsup: adding draft embargo dates: 2026-05-01 to 2026-05-08, tentative.
Jules (legal): Please send the proposed marketplace copy before Wed EOD so I can review.
Harpreet (solutions-eng): I'll create the shared playbook doc and drop test steps + contact for the SI lead.
Alex (sealkey): We'll join Thu and upload the artifacts to the secure share. Thanks all.
Maya (partnerships): Great, see you on Thu. React with :thumbsup: if you're attending.
Omar (infra): :thumbsup:
Diego (security): :thumbsup:
